purpose: Controlled failures across 13 module families and practical RPO/RTO objectives; independently verify original four PASS invariants without damaging existing core.

mandatory_gates.name: Source and baseline binding
mandatory_gates.close_condition: Record exact release-candidate source tree, selected original module/role authority, pre-fault article read and publishing baseline, LIVE baseline or demonstrated truthful OFF state; protect existing Phase3 CI.

mandatory_gates.name: Thirteen controlled failure outcomes
mandatory_gates.close_condition: For each of 13 families reproduce a controlled actual integrated failure/availability loss in safe isolated deployment; capture before/after real adapter or backend states and show mandatory expected behavior. Disabled optional/paid functions may satisfy only after release-candidate fail-closed/unavailable state and unaffected core are independently observed; source-only stubs do not equal full PASS.

mandatory_gates.name: Master behavior and practical recovery objectives
mandatory_gates.close_condition: Independently prove each of 4 Master PASS behaviors and review a credible same-system recovery point/time/data-loss example, record whether objectives are approved, deferred or risk-accepted; no invented production SLA. Founder sets policy/accepts risk; Master does not prescribe a particular numeric target.

mandatory_gates.name: Original evidence and regressions
mandatory_gates.close_condition: Attach per-family failure logs with source and environment identity, timestamps, rejection/commit/readback evidence and rollback/cleanup proof; show baseline CI, Core News Publishing and Live truth/regression green on same candidate. Reuse old proof where source-appropriate, never fabricate hosted logs.

mandatory_gates.name: Independent E8 review, Founder close and T072 handoff
mandatory_gates.close_condition: Independent reviewer validates C1-C4 against original Master T071 four PASS invariants and real negative evidence; no outstanding mandatory HOLD, no old-work regressions, Founder explicitly signs final decision and fixed result published. Only then Final PASS+LOCK and start P4-T072.

route_change_control: No extra T071 closure prerequisite unless traceable to Master RECOV-019..026, four PASS invariants, E1/E2/E5/E8 or independently proven regression/security blocker within original T071 scope. New issue outside route belongs to a separate issue/test, must not silently reopen C1-C5. Founder explicit approval required for scope changes.

transition.scope: Partial DB Write, Fail-Closed, Retry/Idempotency; do not import as new T071 gates
